verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a dedicated Trust Center product that 'helps you automate time-consuming security reviews and gives your prospects the info they need to make a purchase decision,' which matches the core of the story. However, that is a single high-level marketing line with no detail on the hosted public page or its contents. Missing for 10: evidence of live control status display, published certifications, report sharing gated by click-through NDA, hosted public page details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
